request.deadline: Three-month staged launch liquidity deployment after enactment, with monthly reporting; exact full delivery deadline not stated in document.
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with FIRE and ICE assets
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Always-on public dashboards for reserve ratio, supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Legal, compliance, disclosures, treasury reporting, and launch-readiness review
Ecosystem education, DRep communications, partner activation, and launch coordination
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement.
request.what: Fund Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury protocol and BTCfi infrastructure layer by Sundial Protocol and Charms.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference value for a planning budget of about USD 2.0 million.

The requested budget is split into two separated pools of approximately USD 1.0 million each, one for protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity and one for delivery, audit, integrations, dashboards, governance reporting, legal/compliance work, and go-to-market execution.

Pool 1 launch liquidity is described as treasury-supported and treasury-owned, with profits, yield, and returns returned to the Cardano Treasury quarterly after conversion into ada through Cardano-native DEXs.

The launch liquidity principal may be returned to the Treasury after Alchemy reaches a 30-day time-weighted average TVL of at least USD 60 million, subject to a later formal governance proposal and approval.

Alchemy will use a shared BTC reserve architecture where FIRE and ICE are backed by the same BTC reserve, with a target initial reserve ratio of 5.0x and safety zones that constrain minting and redemption below specified reserve-ratio thresholds.
FIRE is proposed as a volatility-absorbing residual BTC exposure asset, while ICE is proposed as a USD-denominated BTC-backed lower-volatility asset with growth potential.
The proposal commits to dashboards, monthly governance reports, milestone gating, deployment pause rules, refund conditions, ADA price protection, and administrator oversight as treasury protections.

The proposal states that Cardano currently lacks a production BTCfi infrastructure layer and that Alchemy would provide reusable infrastructure for wallets, DEXs, DeFi protocols, and future BTCfi projects.

The proposal cites public-market and on-chain Bitcoin-backed structured products, including Strategy, Strive, Apyx, Saturn, and Pendle, as evidence that demand for BTC-backed structured exposure is real and growing.

The proposal acknowledges risks from BTC volatility, oracle, bridge, Charms protocol-layer vulnerabilities, novel asset treatment, delivery, and adoption, and proposes mitigation through overcollateralization, reviews, modeling, staged deployment, dashboards, pause rules, legal work, and integrations.

summary: The document requests 10,000,000 ada for a milestone-gated Cardano BTCfi protocol with separated launch-liquidity and delivery pools, technical reserve mechanics, reporting and oversight commitments, and several treasury-return and pause provisions, while relying partly on proposer assertions about Cardano's BTCfi gap and market opportunity.
